name: usage-pulse
description: Local passive usage telemetry for Kimi Code sessions.

interface.longDescription: Passively records local per-session usage counters and exposes reports through MCP.

hooks.command: py -3 -c "import os,runpy,sys; root=os.environ.get('KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT') or os.getcwd(); sys.argv=['usage-pulse-hook','SessionStart','--provider','kimi']; sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(root,'src')); runpy.run_path(os.path.join(root,'hooks','session_start.py'), run_name='__main__')"
